title: I Tried INSANE Chess Ultimate Setups
summary: Insane Chess Ultimate setups suggested by viewers (e.g. 'play as only parasites'): armies of angels, ghosts, many ghost-pawns.
rules: Chess Ultimate (Steam 3D game): each player drafts an army of funky characters with a point budget (100 points in casual; ranked uses pick brackets by cost) and places them on their side; the King is always included and can be repositioned.

Characters (cost): Checker(1): moves 1 square diagonally forward; captures by jumping like checkers (multi-jumps); promotes to Checker King (can also move backwards) at the end; Giant (squid): occupies 2x2 squares; moves in straight lines 4 squares... attacks squares adjacent to its 2x2 footprint ('Big'); Pawn: normal chess pawn incl. double step, en passant, promotes to Queen; Turtle(4): moves 1 square orthogonally; Copycat(5): comes as a pair that moves together and is knocked out together; Knight(6): normal knight (jumps); Mage(8): swaps location with an ally; Bishop (Rover)(9): moves diagonally; Jester(10): fake king: appears as a king to the enemy; Sludge(12): moves straight up to 2 squares, cannot attack; leaves goop on squares it passes that kills anyone who attacks/enters it; Rook (rock)(13): moves in straight lines (rolls a boulder); Berserker(15): starts with 1-square radius; radius +1 after every knockout; Ghost(15): invisible to opponent; moves 1 square any direction; revealed when it attacks or comes within 1 square of an enemy king/jester; graves on your side show how many ghosts you have and glow when one moves; Penguin(15): when it moves, freezes all adjacent characters (frozen can't move while the penguin stays adjacent); penguin can't be frozen; Parasite(15): moves 1 square any direction; when it attacks or is attacked by a melee character it takes over that character (mind control); Devil(15): spawns a minion on any empty square within a 2-square radius, then sleeps 1 turn; minions move by themselves; Queen (queen bee)(17): moves like a queen; Sniper(17): moves 1 square left/right; shoots the first character in front of it (straight line); sleeps 1 turn after shooting; Bomb(18): moves up to 2 squares any direction; if it attacks or is attacked it explodes, knocking out every character within 1 square (both sides); Prince(18): moves 1 square any direction; may move twice in a turn if its first move is not a capture; Ninja(30): moves up to 3 squares in any direction and can pass through characters; captures by replacement (cost later 25); Angel(40): attaches to an ally; if that ally is knocked out the angel is knocked out instead (extra life)
'Attack' means capture. Win by checkmating the enemy King (Jesters may disguise which king is real).
Some maps have pits/holes in the board.
Self-imposed viewer setups (only parasites, angel stacks, ghost hordes).
